status: shadow: logged and graded only; never feeds projections, probabilities, Top Picks or recommendations
adjustment: shadow_mu = mu * clip(1 + pct_per_point[market] / 100 * team_spread, multiplier_limits); team_spread is the median book spread in the frozen pregame snapshot, from the player's team's side, positive when the team is an underdog

fit.method: OLS of (actual - mu) on [mu, mu * team_spread] per market group (pass, receiving); the level term is not applied
fit.evidence: Leave-one-week-out on weeks 3-7, raw (uncalibrated) probabilities at the consensus line: log loss vs a level-only baseline, passing 0.7649 -> 0.7592, receiving 0.7635 -> 0.7609. Rushing got worse with the spread and is excluded. Weeks 3-7 are in-sample for these coefficients; only weeks from first_prospective_week count as evidence.
